title: Pandi Nattu Thangam
desc: A village chief and his father, who control the village activities besides smuggling sandalwood, create problems for a forest officer, Thangapandian, and a fellow villager, Radha.

title: Kadal Pookkal
desc: Two friends, Karuthaiya and Peter, find their bond tested when a personal tragedy strikes one of their families, leading them on a quest for justice.

title: Jaisurya
desc: Surya, a fraudster, comes across an honest district collector, Jai, who is his lookalike. Things change when circumstances make him step into Jai's shoes.

title: Priyasakhi
desc: Sandhana Krishnan falls in love with Priya, a model. However, the couple strive to navigate challenges, as they come from contrasting families.
